name: @veren/crawler-bundle
description: Use when a DSH profile needs the multi-platform content crawler installed and composed in one step: it is a configuration-only bundle whose patch inserts the single crawler row - the crawl pipeline, the storage adapter with mandatory anonymization, the control service and the HTTP api all live inside that one plugin, so there are no toggles; the member plugin ships as a plain dependency without a bundle declaration of its own, so this patch is the stack's only profile layer; skip it when you want to compose the crawler row by row in your own patch.
